method: Five fresh authenticated SQL requests through container/Nginx; same configured provider and read-only Supabase. All cells compared, ignoring output aliases and unspecified ordering. Not Ragas scoring.

cases.question: What is the latest available inventory snapshot date?
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(inv.snapshot_date) AS latest_snapshot_date FROM commerce.inventory AS inv LIMIT 200

cases.question: How many master product records are in commerce.products?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM commerce.products AS p LIMIT 200

cases.question: Count products by category in the master products table.
cases.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM commerce.products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

cases.question: Which distinct snapshot dates were observed in inventory during December 2022?
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT inv.snapshot_date FROM commerce.inventory AS inv WHERE inv.snapshot_date >= $1 AND inv.snapshot_date < $2 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

cases.question: Count excess duplicate inventory rows beyond the first per (snapshot_date, product_id) key.
cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.cnt - 1), 0) AS excess_duplicate_rows FROM (SELECT inv.snapshot_date, inv.product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM commerce.inventory AS inv GROUP BY inv.snapshot_date, inv.product_id) AS g LIMIT 200
